allow_instructions: Local dev checks are fine: flutter/dart analyze, compile, build, and test.
Running pytest or python test scripts under test/ or scripts/test_*.py is fine.
Read-only git commands (status, diff, log, branch) are fine.
block_instructions: Always require approval for firebase deploy, git push, git reset --hard, and pip install.
Block backend/tools backfill_*, cleanup_*, and any script that writes to production Firestore.
